basic_info.name: IA Impact Labs
basic_info.description: IA Impact Labs is an accelerator program in association with UNTILs- United Nations Technology Innovation Labs with a dedicated ecosystem to support social entrepreneurs and purpose - driven startups to help grow sustainable and scalable businesses. In the 6 months program, the startup undergoes multiple rounds of evaluation across parameters via our diagnostic tools and expert mentor board to determine their stage of impact and business development. This helps in a continuous and consistent identification of their objectives of growth which help in maturing the journey of a young startup into a scalable company.India Accelerator (IA) is India's one and only Global Accelerator Network [GAN] backed institution, helping startups realize true potential by accelerating them into the next phase of growth. They were awarded ‘The Best Accelerator in India’ by National Startup India Awards 2021 and are the leading seed-stage Technology Accelerators in India & one of the fastest growing in Asia. IA has accelerated around 250+ startups so far since their inception in August 2017, out of which 2⁄3 of the portfolio has received follow-on funding.

basic_info.name: Limitless Technology Group
basic_info.description: Limitless Technology Group is an Australian-headquartered e-commerce group that builds, scales and acquires gifting brands across Asia Pacific - Flower Chimp, LVLY, Bloomeroo, CakeRush and Happy Bunch - across six markets. Founded in Kuala Lumpur in 2016, we've served more than a million customers to date.Most e-commerce groups are holding companies - a portfolio of businesses that happen to share a shareholder register. We're the opposite. Our brands share a proprietary order management system, a regional fulfilment network of eight centres, and central marketing, data, procurement and customer service. Each brand keeps its own identity, its own customers and its own market position; almost everything behind the storefront is common.We build brands from scratch (Flower Chimp and CakeRush both became category leaders in their markets), and we acquire and integrate them (LVLY expanded into two new countries and three new fulfilment centres within a year of joining the group).Learn more: https://limitless.my

basic_info.name: Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta
basic_info.description: The Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIMC) was established as the first national institute for Post-Graduate studies and Research in Management by the Government of India in November 1961 in collaboration with Alfred P. Sloan School of Management (MIT), the Government of West Bengal, The Ford Foundation and Indian industry. During its initial years, several prominent faculty formed part of its nucleus, including Paul Samuelson, Jagdish Sheth, J. K. Sengupta, among others.Today, the institute serves as an autonomous body, continually evolving to meet its goals in an ever-changing business environment.The vision of the Institute is to emerge as an International Centre of Excellence in all facets of Management Education, rooted in Indian ethos and societal values. Over the past four decades, IIM Calcutta has blossomed into one of Asia's finest Business Schools. Its strong ties to the business community make it an effective mechanism for the promotion of professional management practices in Indian organizations. Today, IIM Calcutta attracts the best talent in India - a melting pot of academia, industry and research. The best and brightest young men and women pursue its academic programs.
